seed.tagline: Approved users sign in with an emailed code. In dev, pick any user. The database enforces the rules either way.
seed.description: Adds a magic-links/ folder to a project that has the Backend API add-in: an AppUsers table (the approved people; there is no sign-up), a database-side RS256 verifier with row-level security that applies to every generated route, live magic-link sign-in in beta and production, a dev mode that mints a trusted global-admin token and offers a pick-your-user page, and web components for sign-in, user switching and managing the tenant, its email branding and the approved users. Pure SQL and Node: no plpython, no extension, no runtime dependency.
seed.stack: Postgres RLS, JWT, Magic links, Express, Web components
seed.requiresInput: Nothing in dev. A magic-link tenant (created from the admin screen) before beta or production.

replacements.label: Magic-link tenant id
replacements.description: Your tenant on magiclink.effortlessapi.com. Public. Leave blank in dev: the admin screen creates it.

replacements.label: Users table
replacements.description: The database table of approved people (snake_case). AppUsers becomes app_users.

replacements.label: Admin role name
replacements.description: The role that may manage users and the tenant.
